capture_policy: Simulation is paused in an isolated fixture. After route setup, wait300ms for tweens, perform requested scroll and call feedback_layer.finish_all() so frozen route-transition stripes are not part of static layout proof.

note: Geometry warnings include controls behind active modal overlays; inspect actual PNG before treating them as visible bugs. Scroll descendant overflow is excluded.
